jobs.title: Project Manager for Advocacy, Media and Communication - Jerusalem, Palestine & Israel
jobs.description: Requires 3+ years of experience. Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in advocacy, civil society engagement, political communication, or related fields (preferably in Palestine and Israel or the wider Middle East context) Strong understanding of the political and social context in Palestine and Israel, including dynamics affecting civil society, civic space, and non-violent civic engagement Strong analytical and conceptual skills to analyze complex political contexts, design context-sensitive interventions, and translate political analysis into strategic programme approaches
